label: Путь
description: A 10-sentence usage card for путь with route, direction, and metaphorical use.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Core adjective agreement. 1. 'Короткий' matches the masculine noun 'путь'. 2. The phrase is easy to imagine. 3. It is the basic descriptive use of the noun.
Strategic focus: Destination phrase. 1. 'Домой' gives the target of movement. 2. 'Путь' keeps the line compact. 3. This is one of the highest-value route templates.
Strategic focus: Everyday route phrase. 1. 'По пути' is a very common Russian expression. 2. The sentence is short and memorable. 3. It is useful for casual conversation and commuting.
Strategic focus: Location on a route. 1. 'На пути' marks something occurring along the route. 2. The phrase is compact and flexible. 3. It is valuable in both literal and figurative speech.
Strategic focus: Staying on course. 1. 'С пути' gives the source frame. 2. 'Не свернул' adds a decision or failure to deviate. 3. This is useful for story language and metaphor.
Strategic focus: Direction to a place. 1. 'В город' creates a target. 2. 'Путь' stays central as the route noun. 3. This is a simple and very reusable sentence.
Strategic focus: Guidance. 1. 'Указал' is a practical past action. 2. 'Путь' becomes the thing being pointed out. 3. The sentence is useful for directions and leadership language.
Strategic focus: Comparison. 1. 'Наш' agrees with 'путь'. 2. 'Длиннее' gives a comparative shape. 3. This is a great bridge between nouns and comparison language.

Strategic focus: Abstract evaluation. 1. 'Правильный' is a very common adjective in moral and practical contexts. 2. 'Путь' gains metaphorical force here. 3. The line is good for both literal and figurative usage.
Strategic focus: Route through space. 1. 'Через лес' creates a vivid route image. 2. 'Путь' keeps the sentence grounded in movement. 3. This is an excellent travel and narrative sentence.
